remediation.example: defineRoute(router, { method: 'POST', path: '/admin/reports', auth: 'role:admin' }, handler);

howToConfirmFixed: A request from the wrong role returns 403.

title: Another user's record is accessible
description: A signed-in user could read or change a record owned by a different user by using its id.
impact: Customers can see each other's data (insecure direct object reference), a common and serious privacy breach.

remediation.summary: Add the owner declaration to the route so requireOwner checks the record's owner.
steps: Add owner: { entity: '<name>', param: 'id' } to the defineRoute spec.
Include owner_id = ? in the query as a second line of defence.
remediation.example: defineRoute(router, { method: 'GET', path: '/api/orders/:id', auth: 'user', owner: { entity: 'order', param: 'id' } }, handler);

howToConfirmFixed: A request for another user's record returns 403 or 404.

title: Live route missing from routes.manifest.json
description: The running app serves a route that is not listed in routes.manifest.json, so its authorization policy is unknown.
impact: The route was not checked for who may use it; it may be open to anyone.

remediation.summary: Register the route with defineRoute (with auth) and regenerate the manifest.
steps: Find the route in the code and convert it to defineRoute.
Run npm run routes:export to refresh routes.manifest.json.

howToConfirmFixed: Every live route appears in the manifest with an auth value.

title: Weak password accepted
description: Registration or password change accepted a password shorter than 12 characters or one from the common-password list.
impact: Accounts protected by weak passwords are easy to break into by guessing.

remediation.summary: Use validatePassword from src/security/password.ts in every password-setting flow.
steps: Confirm the register, reset and change-password handlers call validatePassword.
Do not add a separate password form that bypasses it.

howToConfirmFixed: 'password1234' and an 11-character password are refused.

title: Password field not masked
description: A password input does not use type="password" or blocks paste.
impact: Passwords are visible on screen and password managers cannot fill them, pushing people to weaker passwords.

remediation.summary: Use <input type="password" autocomplete="current-password"> without onpaste blocking.
steps: Fix the input type in the template.
Remove any script that blocks paste.
remediation.example: <input type="password" name="password" autocomplete="current-password" required>

howToConfirmFixed: The field masks input and paste works.

title: Login not rate limited
description: More than the allowed number of failed logins (5 per account / 20 per IP in 15 minutes) were accepted without a 429 or lock.
impact: Attackers can try thousands of passwords per minute until one works.

remediation.summary: Ensure the login route uses rateLimit: 'login' and the limiter is registered.
steps: Confirm the login defineRoute spec has rateLimit: 'login'.
Confirm RATE_LIMIT_* overrides in .env are not set to huge values.

howToConfirmFixed: The sixth failed login for an account returns 429 with Retry-After.

title: Login reveals whether an account exists
description: Login responses for an unknown email and a wrong password differed in message, status or timing.
impact: Attackers can build a list of valid accounts to target.

remediation.summary: Return the same message and do the dummy password verification for unknown users.
steps: Restore the login handler's constant-time path (verify against a dummy hash when the user is not found).
Use a single message: 'Email or password is incorrect'.

howToConfirmFixed: Both cases return the same status, body and similar timing.

title: Password reset reveals whether an account exists
description: The forgot-password response differed for known and unknown email addresses.
impact: Attackers can confirm which email addresses have accounts.

remediation.summary: Always respond 'If that address is registered, we sent a link.'
steps: Restore the forgot-password handler so both paths return the same page and status.
Send the email only when the account exists, without changing the response.

howToConfirmFixed: Both cases return identical responses.

title: Authenticator code not rate limited
description: More than 5 wrong authenticator codes in 15 minutes were accepted without a 429.
impact: A six-digit code has only a million possibilities; without limits it can be brute-forced in minutes.

remediation.summary: Ensure the MFA verify route uses rateLimit: 'mfa'.
steps: Check the defineRoute spec for the MFA step.
Confirm the limiter is keyed by account.

howToConfirmFixed: The sixth wrong code returns 429.

title: Administrator can sign in without MFA
description: An administrator account completed sign-in without the authenticator step, or could reach admin pages before enrolling.
impact: A stolen admin password alone gives full control of the app and its data.

remediation.summary: Set ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED=1 and ensure the login flow enforces enrolment.
steps: Check ADMIN_MFA_REQUIRED in .env.
Restore the MFA gate in src/features/auth if modified.

howToConfirmFixed: Admin login requires a valid TOTP code before any admin page loads.

title: Registration not rate limited
description: More than 3 registrations per hour from one address were accepted.
impact: Scripts can create thousands of junk accounts, filling the database and enabling abuse.

remediation.summary: Ensure the registration route uses rateLimit: 'registration'.
steps: Check the defineRoute spec for the register route.

howToConfirmFixed: The fourth registration in an hour returns 429.

title: Password reset not rate limited
description: More than the allowed reset requests (3 per hour per account, 10 per IP) were accepted.
impact: Attackers can flood a user with reset emails or probe accounts at scale.

remediation.summary: Ensure the forgot-password route uses rateLimit: 'reset'.
steps: Check the defineRoute spec for the reset route.

howToConfirmFixed: The fourth reset request for an account in an hour returns 429.

title: Rate limit bypassed with a fake IP header
description: Changing the X-Forwarded-For header reset the rate limit, meaning the app trusts client-supplied IP headers.
impact: Attackers can dodge every IP-based limit by changing one header.

remediation.summary: Set TRUST_PROXY_HOPS to the real number of proxies (0 when none).
steps: Fix TRUST_PROXY_HOPS in .env.
Do not set trust proxy to true in code.

howToConfirmFixed: Requests with different X-Forwarded-For values share one limit.

title: Redirect to an outside site allowed
description: A redirect parameter pointing to another domain was followed.
impact: Links to your app can be used to send people to phishing sites that look legitimate.

remediation.summary: Use safeRedirect with an allow-list of local paths.
steps: Replace res.redirect(target) with safeRedirect(res, target, allowList).
Default to '/' when the target is not allowed.
remediation.example: safeRedirect(res, req.valid.query.next, ['/', '/dashboard']);

howToConfirmFixed: ?next=https://evil.example redirects to a local path.

title: Input reflected into a page unescaped
description: A test value with HTML characters sent in a request appeared in the response without escaping.
impact: A crafted link can run script in a visitor's browser (reflected cross-site scripting).

remediation.summary: Render values with <%= %> and never with <%- %>.
steps: Find the template for the route in the finding.
Change <%- to <%= for the value, or set textContent in client script.

howToConfirmFixed: The probe passes: the marker appears escaped (<) in the response.

title: Stored input rendered unescaped
description: A record created with an HTML payload was displayed without escaping when read back.
impact: One user can plant a script that runs for every user who views the record (stored cross-site scripting), stealing sessions or performing actions.

remediation.summary: Render the field with <%= %> in the template.
steps: Locate the view for the entity named in the finding.
Replace <%- field %> with <%= field %>.
If rich formatting is needed, store plain text and format with CSS.

howToConfirmFixed: The probe passes: the stored payload appears escaped.

title: Failed login not logged
description: After a failed login no auth.login.failure event appeared in the security events.
impact: Password-guessing attacks go unnoticed and cannot be investigated afterwards.

remediation.summary: Restore events.emit('auth.login.failure', ...) in the login handler.
steps: Check src/features/auth/login for the emit call on each failure path.

howToConfirmFixed: A failed login produces an auth.login.failure entry in the audit log.

title: Access denial not logged
description: A denied request (wrong role or non-owner) produced no authz.denied event.
impact: Attempts to reach other people's data are invisible to you.

remediation.summary: Use requireRole/requireOwner from src/security/authz.ts, which emit the event; do not hand-roll checks.
steps: Replace custom permission checks with the registry's auth/owner declarations.

howToConfirmFixed: A denied request produces an authz.denied entry.

title: Rejected input not logged
description: A request rejected by validation produced no validation.rejected event.
impact: Probing attempts (many malformed requests) cannot be spotted.

remediation.summary: Use the registry's schema validation, which emits validation.rejected; avoid manual res.status(400) without the event.
steps: Declare schemas in defineRoute instead of validating by hand.

howToConfirmFixed: A malformed request produces a validation.rejected entry.

title: API route returns the wrong content type
description: An /api route responded without Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8.
impact: Browsers might interpret the response as HTML, which can enable script injection through API responses.

remediation.summary: Use res.json() for every API response.
steps: Replace res.send(string) with res.json(object) in API handlers.

howToConfirmFixed: All /api responses have the JSON content type.

title: Idempotency-Key not honoured
description: Repeating a JSON API mutation with the same Idempotency-Key created a second record.
impact: Network retries can double-book, double-charge or duplicate data.

remediation.summary: Set idempotent: true on JSON API mutation routes.
steps: Add idempotent: true to the defineRoute spec.
Add a unique constraint for natural keys in the migration.
remediation.example: defineRoute(router, { method: 'POST', path: '/api/bookings', auth: 'user', idempotent: true, schema: { body: BookingSchema } }, handler);

howToConfirmFixed: A repeated request with the same key returns the stored response and creates nothing new.

title: API key accepted in the URL
description: An API key passed as a query parameter was accepted instead of rejected with 400.
impact: Keys in URLs end up in logs, browser history and referrers, where they can be stolen.

remediation.summary: Accept keys only in the Authorization: Bearer header.
steps: Restore the apikeys middleware from the template, which rejects query-string keys.

howToConfirmFixed: ?api_key=... returns 400.

title: Oversized upload accepted
description: A file larger than UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES was accepted instead of aborted with 413.
impact: Huge uploads can fill the disk or exhaust memory, taking the app down.

remediation.summary: Use the uploads module with its busboy limits; do not add a custom upload handler.
steps: Route uploads through src/features/uploads.
Check UPLOAD_MAX_BYTES in .env.

howToConfirmFixed: An upload over the limit returns 413.

title: Upload with mismatched type accepted
description: A file whose contents did not match its extension or declared type was accepted instead of rejected with 415.
impact: Disguised files (for example HTML named .png) can be stored and later served or executed in a harmful context.

remediation.summary: Use the uploads module, which checks magic bytes, extension and declared type.
steps: Route uploads through src/features/uploads.
Keep UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES to the types you need.

howToConfirmFixed: A text file renamed .png returns 415.

title: SVG upload accepted
description: The upload page accepted an .svg image file. SVG files are really small programs: they can contain scripts that run in the browser of whoever opens them.
impact: SVG files can contain scripts; when viewed they run in the user's browser.

remediation.summary: Remove image/svg+xml from UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES and keep the uploads module's hard block.
steps: Check UPLOAD_ALLOWED_TYPES in .env.
Do not modify the deny-list in the uploads module.

howToConfirmFixed: An SVG upload returns 415.

title: Uploaded file served from the public folder
description: An uploaded file was reachable at a static URL under public/ rather than through the download route.
impact: Files bypass ownership checks and download headers; a disguised file may run as part of your site.

remediation.summary: Store uploads under DATA_DIR/uploads and serve them only via the download route.
steps: Confirm DATA_DIR is outside public/.
Remove any code that copies uploads into public/.

howToConfirmFixed: Uploaded files are not reachable under /public paths.

title: Download response missing safety headers
description: A file download lacked Content-Disposition: attachment, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Content-Security-Policy: sandbox or Cache-Control: private, no-store.
impact: The browser may render the file as part of your site, allowing scripts in files to run.

remediation.summary: Serve downloads through the uploads module's download handler.
steps: Do not write a custom download route; use the uploads feature's route.
If a custom route is needed, set all four headers as in src/features/uploads.

howToConfirmFixed: Download responses include all four headers.

title: Another user's file can be downloaded
description: A signed-in user downloaded a file owned by a different user.
impact: Private documents leak between customers.

remediation.summary: Use the uploads download route, which enforces owner/admin, or add the owner declaration to any custom route.
steps: Add owner: { entity: 'upload', param: 'id' } to the route spec.

howToConfirmFixed: Downloading another user's file returns 403 or 404.

title: Upload quota not enforced
description: A user exceeded the per-user upload quota (count or bytes) without being refused.
impact: One user can fill the disk for everyone.

remediation.summary: Keep the quota check in the uploads module and set UPLOAD_USER_QUOTA_BYTES.
steps: Check UPLOAD_USER_QUOTA_BYTES in .env.
Do not bypass the uploads module.

howToConfirmFixed: An upload beyond the quota returns 413 or 429.

title: Assistant accepts control characters
description: A message containing control characters was accepted by the AI endpoint instead of rejected.
impact: Invisible characters can hide instructions that steer the AI.

remediation.summary: Restore the normalisation and allow-list step in src/features/ai.
steps: Confirm the input pipeline strips Cc/Cf/Co/Cs characters and rejects leftovers.
Do not add a second AI endpoint that skips the pipeline.

howToConfirmFixed: A message with \u0007 returns 422.

title: Assistant accepts oversized input
description: A message longer than AI_MAX_INPUT_CHARS was accepted (or truncated) instead of rejected with 422.
impact: Long inputs can push the safety instructions out of the model's context and run up costs.

remediation.summary: Restore the length check in src/features/ai and set AI_MAX_INPUT_CHARS.
steps: Check AI_MAX_INPUT_CHARS in .env.
Confirm the pipeline rejects rather than truncates.

howToConfirmFixed: A 9,000-character message returns 422.

title: Injection phrase not blocked or not logged
description: A known prompt-injection phrase was passed to the model, or no ai.input.rejected event was recorded.
impact: Users (or text in records) can override the assistant's rules, exposing data or producing harmful output.

remediation.summary: Restore the screening step using injection-patterns.json and its event emission.
steps: Confirm the screening function runs on user text and on record data.
Confirm events.emit('ai.input.rejected', ...) is called on high-precision matches.

howToConfirmFixed: 'Ignore all previous instructions' is refused and logged.

title: Assistant answer rendered as HTML
description: An answer containing HTML was rendered without escaping.
impact: A manipulated answer can run script in the user's browser.

remediation.summary: Render answers with <%= %> only; no Markdown conversion.
steps: Fix the assistant view template.
Remove any markdown or innerHTML rendering in public/js.

howToConfirmFixed: HTML in an answer is shown as text.

title: Assistant still answers when switched off
description: With AI_ENABLED=0 or the admin toggle off, the assistant still responded.
impact: You cannot stop the assistant quickly if it misbehaves or costs spike.

remediation.summary: Restore the per-request kill-switch check in src/features/ai.
steps: Confirm the handler checks config.aiEnabled and the settings.ai_enabled flag before calling the model.

howToConfirmFixed: With the switch off, the endpoint returns 503 with a plain message.

title: Assistant reveals its instructions
description: Asked to repeat its instructions, the assistant's answer overlapped the system prompt by 12 or more consecutive tokens and was not blocked.
impact: Attackers learn the exact rules and can craft ways around them.

remediation.summary: Restore the n-gram overlap filter in the output stage.
steps: Confirm the output filter compares the answer against the system prompt and blocks on overlap.
Confirm events.emit('ai.output.rejected', { reason: 'system-prompt-disclosure' }) is called.

howToConfirmFixed: The probe passes and an ai.output.rejected event appears when disclosure is attempted.

title: Assistant action executed without confirmation
description: A mutating tool proposed by the assistant was executed without the user confirming it through POST /ai/confirm/:proposalId.
impact: The AI can change or delete data on its own, possibly based on injected instructions.

remediation.summary: Route all mutating tools through the proposal and confirmation flow.
steps: Mark the tool as mutating in tools.ts so it returns a proposal.
Never call repository write functions directly from the model response handler.

howToConfirmFixed: A proposed change does not happen until confirmed; the probe passes.
